decisions.mechanic: Left thumb-up ulnar deviation, approximately 18 degrees; palm remains vertical.
decisions.binding: Original unchanged; no local weights, morphs or helper bones.
decisions.acquisition: Assisting hand follows a clearance arc above the left thumb, closes fingers, then follows the tilt.
decisions.thumb: 15-degree reversible local thumb abduction avoids the diagnosed thumb/left-thumb crossing.
decisions.display: Primary owns cyan soft zones; only anatomical left forearm group proxy and source wrist flexor/extensor surfaces. No hand intrinsic muscles.

warning_dispositions: Standard asset QA reported no warnings.
Original UV coordinates include tiles outside 0–1; preserved intentionally. No textures are exported.
A 12 mm illustration proximity band does not imply exact clinical contact. Distal thumb near fraction is small; index/middle provide the clear primary surface contacts.
initial_defects_and_resolution: Initial assist hooked the wrist and left a distal gap. Moved to an overhand grasp.
Whole-thumb extrema concealed a distal-thumb gap. Final checks use original immutable terminal-phalanx vertex IDs.
Elbow was too flexed at about 164.5 degrees. Corrected to about 172.9 degrees before final contact fitting.
All-frame acquisition had thumb/palm crossings. A clearance arc and local articulated thumb abduction removed them.
remaining_primary_work: Actual shared Three.js material and cyan-zone appearance.
Final camera-width fit and complementary-view acceptance.
True canvas alpha, orbit, touch/pinch/reset, loop restart and endpoint resume.
Human anatomy/coaching review; no clinical or EMG certification.
native_modifier_policy: CorrectiveSmooth and Multires retained as original data but disabled; neither is a runtime fix. No DQ reference file because DQ is not used.
